method: Enumerated named dog files with rg across project Assets, Recovered References and Phase 2 Character Masters; checked the unnamed The Dogs overview and Barkington/Fetch WEBP sheets.
Decoded all 53 identified relevant image files with Pillow, measured full-image RGB extrema and alpha, recorded dimensions and SHA-256.
Visually inspected the three dedicated source dossiers, relevant turnaround crops, the eight-dog overview, three original WEBP sheets and current Barkington v002.
Classified each image by content rather than filename. A multi-angle dossier qualifies as a sheet without requiring an exact nine-panel layout.
limits: Absence means no usable dedicated sheet found in the audited project/recovery locations; it does not claim no copy exists in another account or unsupplied archive.
Pixel validity is not final design approval. Existing and new generated sheets remain reference/review material.
Derivative dimensions may reflect enlargement; they are not proof of native source resolution.

canon_constraints.expanded_dog_library: Eight identities audited. The five missing sheets can support future or supporting roles; this does not insert every dog into the initial group.

dogs.name: Chairman Barkington

sources.note: Current v002: four full-body directional views, face, expressions, paw gestures, details and costume/accessories. Back cape is uninterrupted after targeted correction; cigar-free expression references available. Review draft, not final user approval.
Intact 1536×1024 source: four complete full-body angles, six expressions, costume/gear and details. Strong original identity reference.
Visible and usable supplementary crop; boots and rightmost rear view are clipped. Prefer the intact full source sheet or v002 when complete silhouette matters.
Nonblack alternative derivative; pixel-verified. Prefer intact source sheet for complete framing.
Valid single-character hero art; not a turnaround.
512×341 version of the primary dossier; use the larger source above.
Separate 512×341 sheet with six turnaround poses, expression grid, action poses and scene examples; useful corroboration, limited detail.

caveats: v001 is historical; its invented tail opening was corrected in v002.
Neutral and focused faces in v002 are similar; use cigar-free expression tiles for dialogue.
Two black original derivatives do not make the character sheet missing.
dogs.recommendation: Keep v002 and original dossier; no new full sheet needed.

dogs.name: General Fetch

sources.note: 1536×1024 intact source: four full-body angles, five expressions, tactical gear and material/details panels.
Four large views are visible; the crop clips the bottom of boots. Use the full dossier for complete silhouette.
Pixel-identical to ref-turnaround.png.
512×341 dossier thumbnail; larger original source exists.

caveats: A nine-panel remake is optional standardization, not a missing asset.
Keep black/tan Rottweiler face, folded ears, scar and black/gold tactical armor consistent.
dogs.recommendation: Use existing dossier plus views; do not spend on a replacement solely to match a nine-panel format.

dogs.name: Dr Muzzle

sources.note: 1536×1024 intact source: five full-body angles, five expressions, lab equipment and costume/details panels.
Five complete visible views from front through rear, with boots and persistent illuminated muzzle.
Pixel-identical to turnaround.png.
Nonblack recovered 3072×2048 card exists; larger pixels do not establish additional original detail.

caveats: Four black derivatives have recovered counterparts; intact original dossier and turnaround remain available.
Preserve blue eyes, grey/white Husky markings, illuminated muzzle and white/gold lab coat. Do not replace muzzle with glasses.
dogs.recommendation: Use existing original dossier and valid turnaround; no new full sheet needed.
